messages:
ashley: Noticing weird small diffs when running zephyr-70b-int3 longprefill tests. Outputs drift after ~50k tokens; short example below.

lin: What kind of drift? token swap, grammar, or semantics?

ashley: Small tokenization slips and occasional article drop:
```
baseline: "...the defendant presented the evidence, which supported the claim."
observed: "...the defendant present the evidence, which supported the claim."
```
cos-sim between float baseline and quantized run at layer 22 drops from 0.95 -> 0.86.

marco: Is this reproducible across machines? any correlation with sharded serving or relay nodes?

ashley: Reproduces on both canary and dedicated VMs but only when KV-shard-compression is enabled and quantization < int8. Disabled compression or switch to float16 and problem disappears.

qa: Can you paste the bench command and any KV meta dumps?

ashley: Run used: `python tools/longctx_runner.py --model zephyr-70b-int3 --prefill 52000 --kv-compress on --seed 7 --dump-kvmeta 1`. KV excerpt:```
KV_META: shards=6, shard_size=8192
prefill_len=52000
shard_offsets: [0,8192,16384,24576,32768,40960]
last_token_idx: 51999
last_shard_base: 40960
last_shard_write_pos: 11039  <-- exceeds shard_size?
phase_accumulator_last: 51998
phase_accumulator_next: 32768   <-- suspicious saturation to 32768
```

lin: last_shard_write_pos 11039 is definitely wrong for 8192 shard size. Looks like per-shard write position is being stored modulo 2^15 or truncated in the compression layer. phase_accumulator_next capping at 32768 smells like 16-bit signed overflow.

marco: Our quant compression path still uses legacy C kernels that index with int16 for space. That would overflow on >32k counters. Float path uses new backend with 64-bit counters.

ashley: Confirmed: grep shows `uint16_t write_pos` in compress_shard.c for the quant path. Changing to uint32_t in local rebuild removes the symptom.

qa: Nice catch. For immediate mitigation can we gate kv-compress for prefill > 32768? Or add a conversion step before compression to use 32-bit counters?

marco: Quick guard added to runtime: `if (prefill_len > 32768) kv_compress_safe_mode = true`  sets compress to use 32-bit counters. Smoke results: 500 runs, zero divergences. Latency hit ~4%.

lin: We should still fix kernels properly. Create unit test that writes increasing token counts across shards and validates `read_back_pos == expected` across quant vs float builds. Add CI matrix with prefill 10k/40k/80k.

ashley: Filed ENGML-9199 with kernel patch plan and a CI job. Patch changes `uint16_t` -> `uint32_t` in compress_shard + adds sanitizer to prevent silent wrap. Also added telemetry metric `kv_compress_wrap_count`.

devops-bot: [deploy] Canary runtime patched on canary pools (canary-rt-3, canary-rt-4). Rollout id: roll-2026-03-23-319.

marco: Another follow-up: check RoPE phase accumulator math. We saw phase_accumulator_next hitting exactly 32768 which is rotary_base/2 in some implementations. Could be signed half-range wrap. Add tests for phase accumulation using very long priming sequences and assert phase continuity across shard boundaries.

lin: Also run cross-quant sweep (int3/int4/int8) to see whether narrower quant widths change failure distribution. Might point to precision rounding amplifying minor indexing artifacts.

qa: I'll queue experiments: matrix for prefill [20k,50k,100k] x quant [int3,int4,int8,float16] with kv_compress on/off. Will collect tok-mismatch rate, layer-wise cos-sim, and kv_checksum_diffs.

ashley: For SRE: added deterministic prompt for e2e smoke: "Provide a factual summary of the appended transcript:" + repeated paragraph x260. Located at `bench/replicates/engml/zephyr-longtrans/`. Please run on Dedicated nodes.

marco: If the guard stays green for 72h on canary we'll promote but keep two settings behind a feature flag: `kv_compress_safe_mode` and `phase_accumulator_guard`. Plan to revert when kernel fixes land.

devops-bot: [alert] ENGML-9199 created and linked to roll-2026-03-23-319. Severity P2. Artifacts: canary logs, kv-dumps, bench outputs.

lin: Thanks team. Next steps summary: kernel uint16->uint32 fix, add unit tests for shard pos & phase accumulator, run cross-quant sweep, monitor telemetry `kv_compress_wrap_count` and `phase_accum_saturation` for 72h.

ashley: I'll drive the kernel PR and update the issue with links to CI results. Will also add a quick runbook to the issue for oncall.
